name: branding-tangled-serif-monogram-on-knit-label-and-card
title: Interlocking B and C serif monogram on a woven label and card
whatItIs: A white slide with a black monogram where a flared serif B sits over a C with a curved tail. Below, a small woven label with the mark stitched on a chocolate ribbed knit, and a cream card with the mark on a wooden plate beside a ceramic form.
whatItMeans: Refined and artisan; the curling terminals give a hand-drawn elegance.
techniques: Interlock two initials vertically with shared curves.
Use flared serif terminals for a boutique feel.
Show the mark on a small woven label to prove small-size legibility.
Photograph in warm neutrals with natural materials.

vocabulary.definition: Initials arranged one above the other.
A stroke end that widens like a flame.
A fabric tag sewn into clothing.
Props like wood and ceramics used to add warmth.
